title: Connections, displays and controls
body_md:
The illustration of the device is labelled with four letters and eight digits. The legend assigns them as follows:

| Marking | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| A | Operating mode switch |
| B | Connection for the alarm system |
| C | External GPS antenna (optional) |
| D | Status LED |
| Pin 1 | Ground |
| Pin 2 | Measurement input U2 |
| Pin 3 | Measurement input U3 |
| Pin 4 | Measurement input U4 |
| Pin 5 | Measurement input U5 |
| Pin 6 | Output B |
| Pin 7 | Output A |
| Pin 8 | Permanent plus 12 V |
